# Anutech Digital Pvt Ltd

> Delhi-based Google Premier Partner (since 2014). We sell Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and Zoho Workplace licences, domains, cPanel hosting, SSL and business email to Indian businesses — priced in rupees, with an 18% GST invoice (HSN 998313, input-credit eligible), free migration, and WhatsApp support. Maker of ResellerOS. GSTIN 07ABDCA0298H1ZP.

## Business email pricing (per user / month, GST 18% extra, annual billing)

- Google Workspace Business Starter — ₹270 (30 GB per user)
- Google Workspace Business Standard — ₹736 (2 TB per user, recordings) — most teams pick this
- Google Workspace Business Plus — ₹1,380 (5 TB, Vault, eDiscovery)
- Microsoft 365 Business Basic — ₹145 (web Office, 50 GB mail)
- Microsoft 365 Business Standard — ₹770 (desktop Office, 1 TB)
- Zoho Workplace Standard — ₹90 (mail plus Writer, Sheet, Show) — cheapest full suite

Monthly (flexible) billing is higher per user; annual billing saves roughly 12–17%. Renewal is at the same published rate. Nothing is charged until the customer approves a quote; payment is by Razorpay (UPI, card, netbanking).

## Domains (per year, GST extra)

- .in ₹499 first year, renews ₹799 · .co.in ₹599/₹899 · .com ₹899/₹1,199 · .org ₹1,099/₹1,299 · .net ₹1,199/₹1,399 · .store ₹249/₹4,199 · .io ₹3,899/₹4,299 · .ai ₹6,999/₹7,499
- The renewal price is always printed next to the first-year price. The domain is ₹0 with a yearly hosting plan.

## Hosting (cPanel on NVMe, Mumbai/Bengaluru)

- Starter ₹159/mo (yearly), Business ₹359/mo, Agency ₹799/mo. Free SSL, daily backups, free migration.
